open_gaps:
FINDING, not changed, needs a lead decision: toc::line_of does not find a placed blank line of a paragraph with no glyph, because composition gives it an empty source span at the paragraph's END (native probe-marker-only-lines.log: "Intro
<index>
Body
" lines (0,5), (10,10), (10,14), paragraph (6,10)). So the premise that an empty heading has no placed line does not hold natively: it has one, and has no entry only because line_of misses it and it counts as overset. The same miss applies to every line_of caller on such a paragraph: an index mark there reads unplaced although place_markers puts the marker on its page, and a cross-reference destination there reads Unplaced. Read from code and the probe; no test of those two. Fixing line_of itself would change those answers and would make a blank paragraph with a mapped style a running-text occurrence, so it was left alone. blank_line_of is read only for the TOC decision and for gap reasons

OPEN: with include_overset on, a placed empty heading (no marker) is still listed with empty text, as before this lane. The marker-only rule does not cover it; the reading "as an empty heading" holds only with include_overset off

OPEN: a section marker in a TOC entry or a cross-reference has a typed gap, not its value, because generate_toc, TocGenerateRequest and XrefContext carry no sections. A heading holding one shows no section name there. Giving the value needs a sections input on those public calls: a lane decision
NOT_PROVEN: U+FFFC in derived text is proven with toy shaping only. No fixture font maps it, so a source holding it does not compose natively (F-R55-13, out of scope)
NOT_PROVEN by a native test: endnote text and captured topics are proven with toy shaping; the native file covers TOC, running and cross-reference text

NOT_INSPECTED: other crates for copies of story text beyond the callers of these generators; MT-174 rows beyond AC-002
UNVERIFIED (D5): InDesign handling of markers in a TOC entry, cross-reference or running header; flush space and inner terminators in an entry
notes.behaviour_change: Cross-reference text now trims U+2029 and the other terminators, where it trimmed only U+000A and U+000D. An inner terminator in a character-style range, a note body or a captured selection is a space. U+FFFC leaves entry text. An index topic can no longer be captured from a selection holding a page-number, section or cross-reference marker or a reserved code point. New public fields: marker_gaps on five result structs, resolved_text on NoteHost. Follow-up: a marker-only heading moves from omitted_overset to omitted_no_text in generate_table_of_contents, and a gap of a placed marker-only paragraph now names composition's state, where it read NotPlaced. New public fields: omitted_marker_gaps on GeneratedStory and TocGenerated, omitted_no_text on TocGenerated. No answer of composition changed (fold_proof)
